mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sensory endings was worthwhile because the resulting description tied the glands, vessels and nerves to the skin's functions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to join the epidermis and dermis was confusing: their physical relationship suggested a match, but the game did not explain why the dermis needed vessels first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the epidermal barrier could not yet join the dermis; inspecting the dermis revealed that it first needed blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: The required order for adding vessels before joining the skin layers felt somewhat arbitrary because its purpose was not clear at the failed attempt.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it develops another relationship between systems. This chapter made the skin's structures and functions clear, though several fittings were predictable.
